desc:
The game will be going in a Recode stage, there will be less major content updates but do expect every glaring issues you face in the game to be fixed or revamped.

Welcome to Untitled Parkour Game! 

Explore The Silly City and level up through parkouring, completing time trials, doing quests, missions & more!

Everything you see is subject to change, bugs are prone to occur often.

We're mainly inspired by PARKOUR Legacy, PARKOUR Reborn and the Mirror's Edge game series. You may even see major resemblance of those series in the game! We also take partial inspiration from other games such as Dying Light 2 and more..

This game has NO stolen assets, everything is hand-made by our Developers and Contributors. 

Have any suggestions for the game? Feel free to share them in our ROBLOX Communities forum or our Community Server! (13+)
 
⚠️  Any usage of exploits will result in a UNAPPEALABLE PERMANENT BAN no matter what.  ⚠️
